key.name: active-apps
key.description: Runtime list used by preferences, including hidden and passive apps. Cleared when the extension starts or stops.

key.name: app-overrides
key.description: JSON object keyed by StatusNotifierItem Id, containing the discovered name, custom label, hidden state, and ordering priority for each application. Equal priorities retain registration order.

key.name: max-menu-height
key.description: The height in pixels at which the Running Apps menu becomes scrollable.

key.name: hide-passive-indicators
key.description: Hide StatusNotifierItems whose status is Passive.
